approval_case.title: Update one pull-request record when its decision changes
approval_case.situation: Pull request 418 already has one open review record, but its commit changed and the new security check fails. The owner says this revision needs repair.
approval_case.hao_request: A new run proposes another generic review message.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Update the existing pull-request record instead of creating a duplicate. Deliver one material-change update that names commit def456 and the failed security check. Recommend rejecting the current revision and returning it to the owner. Use direct replies: `reject revision` records the rejection and starts owner repair; `keep open` leaves the review open. May follows the owner to a new passing revision before asking for review again.
